notes: NGON NGU: khi tich 'Ap ngon ngu da chon', tool BO HET cac cau ghim ngon ngu trong prompt goc va truyen chi theo DUNG MOT ngon ngu da chon, mac ke video/kich ban goc la ngon ngu gi. Truoc day chi THEM chi thi ngon ngu ma van de nguyen cac cau 'viet bang English', 'natural American English', 'doc gia My/Au' trong prompt -> model nhan 2 lenh trai nhau nen ket qua lai ra tieng Anh. Nay strip_language_rules() thay 6 cau ghim do bang ngon ngu da chon (ca trong prompt chinh lan addendum), nen prompt gui model KHONG CON cau ghim tieng Anh nao. Them CAPTION_CTA: cau ket caption duoc dich theo ngon ngu (16 ngon ngu) va tu chuan hoa - neu model tra ve CTA tieng Anh cu thi tu bo va thay bang CTA dung ngon ngu. KHONG tich = prompt y nguyen nhu cu (da kiem: giong het tung byte). Da test: tich Japanese -> prompt khong con 'American English'/'My/Au', chi con Japanese; ca 16 ngon ngu deu co ten gon + CTA; config khong bi ghi de.
